# Summary

Promote candidate and retire exact prior image

## Action

Install selected Framework Methodology and refresh Project MCP **means** the final local Action that replaces the installed Framework with the exact verified `LAYER_1_FRAMEWORK_METHODOLOGY` product, installs the bound `ca` Skill, and restarts or reuses the current Project MCP for a smoke check.

## Scope

The Action requires CA-O-164's current validated active sources, passing local-release tool tests under the declared validation scope (complete by default; focused only with an explicit current record), exact compiled product, and the exact verified package, runtime, `ca`, and candidate image prepared by the same Workflow. Under one installation lock it preserves protected settings and Project state, clears only replaceable installed Framework members, and copies `LAYER_1_FRAMEWORK_METHODOLOGY` as-is into `.caprmedio_caprmedio/000_CAPRMEDIO_framework/`. It then installs that same package/runtime and bound `ca` payload, and restarts or reuses the current Project MCP for the declared smoke check. First installation has no required prior image or installed package; an existing installation is preserved until its replacement is ready.

## Details

Commit the successful installed clear and product copy separately, staging only each transition's owned changes. These checkpoints remain separate within this Action. Other successful state-changing installation steps also retain their own scoped commit; unchanged or read-only steps record results without empty commits. A failed transition or commit stops before the next transition.

This Action considers all accumulated obsolete release-owned containers and images for the current Project, not only the immediate predecessor. Before Project-MCP startup, it may remove exactly identified stopped obsolete containers so retained old containers do not prevent startup. The existing exact-prior Project-MCP replacement path may stop and remove that prior container through its ownership checks; accumulated cleanup does not stop other running containers. After installed-package verification and successful Project-MCP startup/smoke, repeat eligible stopped-container cleanup and remove the now-unused obsolete images.

Derive each exact immutable image/container identity, Project-root ownership and noncandidate status from actual release, build, launcher or start evidence and matching Docker inspection. A tag prefix or version age alone proves neither ownership nor eligibility. Preserve the exact promoted candidate, running containers outside the existing exact-prior replacement path, unrelated or other-Project resources, required protected references, and images retained by any container. Unknown ownership, unknown code identity or unavailable inspection means retain and report, including unproven orphan images. Never force-delete containers or prune globally. Record each target's ownership and code evidence, use/protection check and actual removal or retention outcome through the shared Run/Action Journal evidence. Blocked or failed cleanup is reported as pending; successful installation does not imply complete cleanup.

The Action never copies from an installed tree as source authority, broadens the active source set, creates another Workflow, pushes, opens a PR, removes unrelated Project state, or retries an uncertain effect. A failed copy, Skill installation, MCP restart/reuse, or smoke check stops with actual evidence and leaves no claim of completed installation.

The Operator-selected retention scope is this Project only, not all CAPRMEDIO images on the host. The retained image is the exact current-Version candidate admitted by this successful release, whose canonical version/build-date/digest naming was prepared after the green declared local validation scope; the complete suite remains the default and CA-O-188 public release remains full-suite. Other digests do not earn retention merely from equal fingerprints or Versions. Image removal requires inspected matching Project identity, host Project root and control root plus valid runtime schema/fingerprint; a prior container link is not image ownership. The existing exact-prior Project-MCP replacement path may stop/remove its positively owned container when its digest differs from the candidate even if fingerprints match. All other running containers remain untouched. Image cleanup requires positive exact-candidate launch and smoke verification, including first installation; otherwise skip removal and report pending. Preserve all container-referenced images and foreign/unowned resources. Actual effect completion is independent of Journal completeness; append observed facts without a Journal receipt gate.

## Action

Initialize the first Framework runtime and project-local `ca` Skill **means** the explicit Operator-invoked Action that creates one initial runtime selection only from the empty carrier state defined by CA-R-1881.

The Action binds one sealed current source frontier, one empty runtime/Skill state, one complete manifest-addressed package, one immutable image digest, explicit target-Project metadata, settings, Project Structure and selected control-root `.caprmedio_<project>/operators_registry.toml` bytes, selected extension/configuration revisions from one admitted pinned catalog, and one canonical Action Run. Its canonical started-Run input binds `requested_run_id`, package-manifest SHA-256, sealed source-context SHA-256, catalog/configuration identity and immutable image digest as one exact intent. It is a bootstrap Action outside CA-O-164's selected Release Version Workflow.

The Action invokes the admitted FRAMEWORK_INITIALIZATION Tool boundary once. CA-R-1881, CA-M-338 and CA-D-575 remain their owning Engine/TOOLS authority; this Action only binds to their admitted package and carrier evidence. It reopens the exact source and started-Run evidence before any effect; verifies the complete package, hook-free Skill, and inspected immutable image digest and labels bound to the started intent and actual manifest and source-context digests; publishes the Skill; then publishes the reusable package selector and this Project's `.caprmedio_runtime/installation/current.toml` state/environment binding as final activation points and emits the terminal result through the schema-V5 Work Journal. Tool-call evidence attaches to the Action Run by evidence references and parentage; it does not create a Tool Run. Reusing `requested_run_id` with a changed manifest, source-context, catalog/configuration or image digest permits only existing-Run inspection or recovery; it does not create another started evidence entry or source ledger. It does not create a selected-workflow binding, candidate N+1, Release Version Run, source delivery, canonical Projection, hook, global setting, MCP registration, image removal, automatic retry, or permanent bootstrap configuration. # Summary

Finalize the actual public history link

## Action

Finalize the actual public history link **means** the mechanical action that either records a no-op for an already present actual PR link or appends a newly created PR’s exact URL to the concise Version History, follows up the commit and push, and refreshes the same PR.

## Details

The actual URL is required. The Action preserves its Tool-call input/result/effect/report references on its parent Action Run. It does not create another PR, guess a URL, merge, or replay an unknown remote outcome.
